Title: New player with a few doubts, thx everyone

Messages.Author: Zouse
Messages.Body:
Im coming back to VTES after a long time. Back in the time I only play a bit really so could be so elemental questions, sorry for that. Any help is welcome.

I have plenty doubts regarding some specific movements in the game.

1. Lets said I have my vamps lock. My preadator came to bleed me. I Said OK, not blocking. Then he modified Conditioning +3. Can I in this moment to use a Wake card and deflect the bleed?

2. Same case, but Im unlock. I did not tried to block, and after he increase the bleed, redirect it? I just let it pass on purpose to deflect…that’s ok?

3. Wirt of Acceptance makes a vamp Camarilla. If Im a cardinal sabbat, I keep my title?

4. Im making a not bleed, not political action. So, I increased 3 stealth, my prey catch me with 3 intercept, so we go combat. I used my shadow body, combat ends+action continues. I guess my prey can still block it with another vamp if he have another 3 intercepts. BUT can he wakes the same vamp after combat and block again keeping the 3 intercepts he drop earlier?

5. Cards saying do not replace till…. That means I do not replace that card, but If I drop any other card, can I replace it? Or that Do not replace means I cannot replace Any card till action is finished or so ever…

More will come I think...but for the moment, thats the most urgent ones XD

Appreciate your support.

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
1. Yes.
2. Yes.
3. No, sect related titles are lost.
4. Yes, they can, intercept lasts for duration of the action.
5. You don't replace only a card that specificly say it, other cards are replaced normal no matter you've played a card that does not replace.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Palamedes wrote:
> 3. No, sect related titles are lost.
>
They go 'inert', and will come back into being if you switch back to the right sect. Although this is less likely if you're deliberately changing clan/sect yourself, it can happen involuntarily with - for example - Derange. When you switch back from being a Camarilla Malk to being a Sabbat Lasombra, you want that Cardinal back!

While the title is inert, it is ignored except for:

- if the vampire receives a new title, the old inert one is properly lost at that point, and

- if another vampire brings in a title that would contests the inert title, the inert title is lost without contesting it.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
Saying you decline blocks is final, except the case where a bleed is bounced back to you during the same action.

Modifiers can be played after blocks are declined, and so can reactions - including wakes and bounces (as long as they’re not reactions that explicitly try to block).
